description: Who bought a token in the first 60 seconds after trading opened: how many wallets, what share of supply they took and still hold, how many bought in the very block trading opened, and which early buyers are linked to each other or to the dev. 0x tokens on Robinhood Chain, Ethereum or Base (pass chain, or it finds it): linked means they moved the token between them. Also takes a Solana mint (pump.fun and other launches): there, linked also means funded by the same wallet shortly before buying, funded by the dev, bought in one transaction or paid each other's fees, and it says how many of the biggest buyers were brand-new wallets. On Solana, earlyBought counts every buy (fast in-and-out trading can push it past 100%); heldAtWindowEnd is what they still held when the window closed. Use for 'is this bundled?', 'was the launch sniped?'.

chain.description: For a 0x address: the chain. Default: Robinhood Chain if the token is there, else Ethereum, else Base

seconds.description: Early window after trading opened, in seconds. Default 60, max 600

token.description: Token contract address (0x...) on Robinhood Chain, Ethereum or Base, or a Solana mint

name: bundle_check
title: Was the launch bundled?
